edges.reason: Deployer msg.sender is stored as the admin state variable in the constructor.
constructor assigns the admin state variable.
validPayment keys the payments mapping with the untrusted msg.sender to enforce per-payer state.
validPayment modifier gates execution of makePayment until the payment state check passes.
onlyAdmin compares the untrusted msg.sender against the stored admin address.
onlyAdmin reads the admin state variable as the authority for the check.
onlyAdmin modifier gates the privileged goodNightSweetPrince function.
selfdestruct forwards the contract balance to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
goodNightSweetPrince reaches the selfdestruct operation only behind the admin check.
msg.sender is embedded into the hashed preimage inside generatePreimage.
Caller-supplied hash _h is compared with the reconstructed image in makePayment.
Caller-supplied _v flows into signature recovery in makePayment.
Caller-supplied _r flows into signature recovery in makePayment.
Caller-supplied _s flows into signature recovery in makePayment.
_paymentNumber parameter drives state lookup and record creation in makePayment.
_paymentMethod parameter selects the settlement branch in makePayment.
_chargeAmountInWei parameter determines the charged amount in makePayment.
_prefixed parameter chooses the hashing path in makePayment.
payment number is packed into the preimage hash.
payment method is packed into the preimage hash.
charge amount is packed into the preimage hash.
_paymentNumber argument feeds the preimage encoding.
_chargeAmountInWei argument feeds the preimage encoding.
_paymentMethod argument feeds the preimage encoding.
_preimage argument is hashed with the ERC191 prefix.
generatePreimage result is passed into generatePrefixedPreimage.
ERC191 PREFIX constant is prepended to the preimage before hashing.
Local preimage value is forwarded to the prefixed preimage generator.
_h is the digest passed to ecrecover.
_v is passed to ecrecover.
_r is passed to ecrecover.
_s is passed to ecrecover.
makePayment invokes ecrecover after validating the reconstructed image.
Recovered signer address gates payment acceptance against the hardcoded SIGNER.
Hardcoded SIGNER is the reference identity used to authorise the payment.
msg.sender is the outer mapping key when writing the payment record.
makePayment writes the PaymentStruct into the payments mapping before external calls.
Payment record is persisted into the payments state mapping.
_paymentNumber is the inner mapping key of the payment record write.
_chargeAmountInWei is stored inside the PaymentStruct record.
validPayment reads payments state to reject already-executed payments.
makePayment executes the numPayments counter increment.
msg.sender is the key whose numPayments counter is incremented.
Incremented counter is written back to the numPayments state variable.
Counter increment relies on SafeMath.add arithmetic with an overflow require.
First operand flows into SafeMath.add.
Second operand flows into SafeMath.add.
ETH settlement branch of makePayment performs HOTWALLET.transfer(msg.value).
HOTWALLET.transfer sends the payment value to the hardcoded hot wallet address.
RTC settlement branch of makePayment invokes RTI.transferFrom.
RTI constant token interface is the target of the transferFrom external call.
RTI is bound to the hardcoded TOKENADDRESS constant.
RTI.transferFrom performs an external callback into the token contract's transferFrom implementation.
A malicious token at TOKENADDRESS could re-enter makePayment through the transferFrom external call.
Token transferFrom callback executes while makePayment is still on the stack, enabling reentrancy.
